entities.title: fix-network sources
entities.summary: All of fix-network's Rust modules, flat: the command line, gathering a snapshot of the Mac's network, judging it, repairing it, and reporting.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole tool. main.rs parses the command line and runs diagnose or fix; facts.rs gathers a snapshot through parse.rs; assess.rs and corp.rs turn it into checks and findings with remedies (types in model.rs); repair.rs plans and runs the repair steps; report.rs prints text or JSON; run.rs keeps the per-run log directory; sys.rs is the one trait through which everything reaches the machine.
boundaries: Everything the tool does to or asks of the machine (commands, name lookups, TCP connections, waiting, the clock, SSH detection, the Wi-Fi watchdog) goes through the Sys trait in sys.rs; no other module runs a process or opens a socket.
The tests replace the machine with the scripted Mac in sys.rs (module fake); they never change a real network.
Only macOS is supported: main.rs refuses any other OS before touching the machine.
